rootProductDecisions.R1: Do NOT alter legacy activity_logs.completed_at NOT NULL/default on an unverifiable schema. Record NEW game-owned receipt/review event times DB-side for new events. SQL now() is the transaction start, NOT the commit instant - choose one explicit authoritative DB clock capture and document the timeliness semantics; do not claim exact commit. rootProductDecisions.R2: Explicit DB IANA day conversion; invalid or missing zone fails closed. The TS helper is for display parity only.
rootProductDecisions.R3: Unconditional per-child, namespaced advisory xact lock for all game-integrated habit + game mutations, with an exact stable key specified. A batch acquires all child keys sorted by UUID before the existing locks. Never a global lock. Preserve family auth before any target lock. Baseline-vs-changed perf evidence required.
rootProductDecisions.R4: Preserve existing habit undo / PIN / points behaviour. Do not add parent PIN to child self-undo, and do not change approved terminal transitions. New game-owned immutable receipt / audit snapshots must survive the old log DELETE; transactional sync before/after the current undo as needed.
rootProductDecisions.R6: A separate versioned game response schema; the closed habit enum stays closed.
rootProductDecisions.R7: A paused family/day, or an immediate game master-disable, blocks BOTH main and bonus new admissions. Historical data is retained; the current interactive attempt pauses / goes read-only until permitted, with no penalty.
rootProductDecisions.R8: The journey index advances once at main START. An expired previous-day attempt retains its original journey day, read-only. The next main uses the next index - never a third interactive slot carried over from yesterday.
rootProductDecisions.bonus: Requires the main attempt to be already STARTED - never requires winning or solving. It may follow an abandon/skip when the task criteria are eligible.

criticalBug.summary: The migration breaks EVERY parent and child habit completion. The receipt trigger is BEFORE INSERT on public.activity_logs and inserts into thinking_game_habit_receipts whose log_id FK to activity_logs(id) is NOT deferrable - so the parent row does not exist yet and the FK fails.

criticalBug.reproduction: Real PostgreSQL 18.4, disposable DB omp_verify_1792575868, valid fixtures (families/child_profiles/habit_activities all insert successfully). insert into public.activity_logs (...) -> ERROR: insert or update on table thinking_game_habit_receipts violates foreign key constraint thinking_game_habit_receipts_log_id_fkey; DETAIL: Key (log_id)=(44444444-...) is not present in table activity_logs; CONTEXT: PL/pgSQL function public.thinking_game_activity_lock_and_receipt() line 5

The advisory lock likely needs to be taken before row work, so split it: a BEFORE trigger that only takes the advisory lock, and a separate AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE trigger that writes the receipt. The log_id FK is then satisfied normally.
